name: Codocraft Smart Notify – Notification Bar, Hello Bar Alternative, Countdown Timer, Image Banner & Promo Plugin
author: Codocraft Solutions

sections.description:
Codocraft Smart Notify is a powerful WordPress Notification Bar plugin built to turn your website visitors into customers.

Easily create announcement bars, promo offers, WooCommerce notification bars, image banner notifications, and countdown timers — all from one simple, lightweight dashboard.

🚀 Looking for a Hello Bar alternative?
This plugin gives you more flexibility, better performance, and modern features without slowing down your website. Boost your conversion rate instantly by grabbing attention with sticky header bars, image-based banners, and real-time countdown timers.

💡 Why Choose Codocraft Smart Notify?

  • High-Converting Bars: Turn traffic into revenue with strategic call-to-actions.
  • Image Notification Bars: Visually grab user attention with banner-style notifications.
  • Urgency & Scarcity: Increase sales using real-time sales countdown timers.
  • Device Targeting: Show specific messages to mobile or desktop users.
  • Built-in Analytics: Track performance with real-time CTR and views data.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for Core Web Vitals with zero impact on SEO.

Key Features

  • 🔥 5 Powerful Notification Types:
    • Promo / Offers Bar
    • Coupon / Deal Code Bar
    • Simple Text Announcement
    • Image / Banner Notification Bar
    • Urgency Countdown Timer
  • 🖼️ Image Notification Bar – Display banners with images for higher engagement.
  • ⏳ Sales Countdown Timer – Perfect for flash sales and limited-time offers.
  • 🎯 Smart Targeting – Control visibility by device (Desktop/Mobile).
  • 📊 Real-Time Analytics – Track clicks and views to measure performance.
  • 📱 Mobile Friendly – Fully responsive and touch-optimized.
  • 🎨 Custom Styling – Match your brand colors and fonts perfectly.

Use Cases

  • Show image banner notifications for seasonal promotions or branding.
  • Display free shipping bar for WooCommerce stores to increase AOV.
  • Create urgency for product launches with countdown timer bars.
  • Promote discount codes using a sticky coupon notification bar.
  • Announce updates or alerts using a prominent announcement bar.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codocraft-smart-notify folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Codocraft Smart Notify in your dashboard to create your first bar.
sections.faq:
Is this a Hello Bar alternative?

Yes! It provides similar (and more) features but is built to be faster and easier to use.

Can I create image notification bars?

Absolutely! You can upload images to create visual banner-style notifications.

Can I use it with WooCommerce?

Yes, it is fully compatible and perfect for showing free shipping or discount alerts.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, every bar type is fully responsive and looks great on all screen sizes.
